paper.title_en: Effects of QCD Equation of State on Cosmological Parameters and Stochastic Gravitational-Waves Spectrum
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the thermodynamic evolution of the early Universe across the QCD crossover and up to the electroweak (EW) scale, emphasizing the systematic impact of the QCD equation of state (EoS) and electroweak degrees of freedom on thermodynamic variables, cosmological parameters, and gravitational-wave observables. Using the HotQCD EoS as a baseline, we employ Gaussian Process (GP) regression to generate ensembles of 1000 thermodynamically consistent EoS samples, each extrapolated to high temperatures with and without EW contributions. For each ensemble, we solve the Friedmann equations to obtain the expansion history and compute gravitational-wave (GW) observables, including the instantaneous spectral tilt $n_{gw}(f)$ and the normalized GW energy density $Ω_{gw}(f)/Ω_{gw}^{\rm rad}$. We find that including the EW sector is the dominant effect across all observables, outweighing differences among QCD baseline models that share the same lattice calibration. In particular, EW contributions drive the EoS toward the radiation-dominated limit earlier, reduce excursions of the speed of sound toward the causality bound, suppress transient fluctuations in the Hubble and kinematic parameters near $t \sim 10^{-5}$ s, and qualitatively change the GW spectrum from a strongly frequency-dependent signal to a flat, suppressed plateau. These results demonstrate that accurate modeling of the electroweak sector is essential for an unbiased extraction of QCD-era physics from the stochastic gravitational-wave background.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文系统研究QCD交叉区至电弱尺度的状态方程对宇宙学参数与随机引力波谱的影响，使用HotQCD基线并结合高斯过程回归生成1000个热力学一致的样本，求解Friedmann方程并计算引力波可观测量的方法学较为扎实；结论明确指出电弱扇区贡献主导各项观测量并定性改变引力波谱，与随机引力波背景的提取直接相关，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: QCD状态方程对宇宙学参数与随机引力波谱的影响
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了早期宇宙在QCD交叉区并直至电弱（EW）尺度的热力学演化，强调QCD状态方程（EoS）与电弱自由度对热力学变量、宇宙学参数和引力波可观测量的系统性影响。以HotQCD状态方程为基线，我们采用高斯过程（GP）回归生成1000个热力学一致的状态方程样本组成的系综，每个样本都在包含和不包含电弱贡献的情况下外推至高温。对每个系综，我们求解Friedmann方程以获得膨胀历史，并计算引力波（GW）观测量，包括瞬时谱倾斜 $n_{gw}(f)$ 和归一化引力波能量密度 $Ω_{gw}(f)/Ω_{gw}^{\rm rad}$。我们发现，在所有观测量中，纳入电弱扇区都是主导效应，其影响超过共享相同格点标定的QCD基线模型之间的差异。特别地，电弱贡献使状态方程更早趋近辐射主导极限，减小声速向因果性界限的偏移，抑制 $t \sim 10^{-5}$ s 附近哈勃参数与运动学参数的瞬态涨落，并将引力波谱从强烈依赖频率的信号定性地变为平坦、受抑制的平台。这些结果表明，对电弱扇区的精确建模对于从随机引力波背景中无偏地提取QCD时期物理是必不可少的。
